about.title: Dunsmuir Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Dunsmuir is a small town, but its stretch of I-5 carries steady through-traffic alongside local streets like Dunsmuir Avenue and Castle Avenue, where crashes still happen even in a community this size. Recent public records show injury collisions occurring here, often clustering on Saturday evenings when travel and local activity overlap. Whether you were hurt on the interstate, at a local intersection, or on the I-5 southbound connector, the aftermath can mean medical bills, missed work, and confusing calls from an insurance adjuster. We're a personal injury practice ready to evaluate your situation at no upfront cost. We work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover. Acting early matters: evidence along rural highway shoulders and small-town intersections can disappear quickly, and California's filing deadlines are firm.

whyChoose.title: What Matters Most After a Dunsmuir Crash

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, though claims against a government entity can require notice in as little as six months. Missing these windows can end your case before it starts.

items.title: Comparative Fault Still Protects You
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so you can still recover compensation even if you're partly responsible for the crash. Your recovery is simply reduced by your share of fault, not eliminated.

items.title: Careful Handling of Insurer Contact
items.desc: Giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer before speaking with an attorney can weaken your claim. We can help you avoid early missteps and preserve evidence like photos, witness statements, and crash reports.

items.question: Do I need a police report if my crash happened on I-5 near Dunsmuir?
items.answer: A police or CHP report is helpful but not always required to pursue a claim. If your crash occurred on I-5, the California Highway Patrol likely responded, and that report can be useful evidence. We can help you obtain it and identify other supporting evidence if a report wasn't filed.

items.question: What if the crash happened on a city street like Castle Avenue instead of the highway?
items.answer: The same California injury laws apply whether the crash happened on I-5 or a local street like Castle Avenue or Dunsmuir Avenue. What matters most is documenting the scene, seeking medical care, and acting before the statute of limitations runs. We can walk you through next steps regardless of where in Dunsmuir the crash occurred.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. Our initial consultation is free, and we work on contingency, meaning we only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.
